scope: Source-only review. No packaging, extraction, artifact decoding, model/data/metric execution.
correctness_checks: Root path resolves to repository root; all P regular files except bytecode/.DS_Store are included. Directory and file symlinks rejected.
Exact existing 52-run/224-file manifest verifies opaque source size/hash before inclusion.
Archive names reject absolute paths, traversal and duplicates; tar entries are re-opened and required regular, unique and exactly equal to expected inventory plus internal manifest.
Every archived file content is streamed through SHA256 before publishing final filename; internal/external inventory bytes agree.
Bundle, RESTORE.md and three delivery ZIPs are included without executing model or reading competition data.
Existing output/temp/inventory/receipt paths are refused; intended workflow is one invocation after all source/result files close.

blocking_findings.finding: git bundle list-heads plus git bundle verify in the populated repository accepts an incremental bundle whose prerequisite commits are already present.
blocking_findings.impact: RESTORE.md instructs clone in an empty directory. Such a bundle can pass current checks but fail standalone restoration.
blocking_findings.required_fix: Reject all prerequisite headers, or verify the bundle in a newly initialized empty temporary repository. Keep current HEAD binding.

nonblocking_limits: The byte inventory authenticates the packed snapshot, not that all current files are committed. Run after final source commit and record the full HEAD as planned.
This research backup excludes organizer dataset bodies, large external prediction caches and automatic Python/CUDA environment recreation.
No generated packager execution was requested or performed. Independent post-pack byte audit remains required.
